run_download_warc_cli: run the download_warc CLI to download WARC files from Common Crawl metadata dataset
run_get_args: run get_args to parse CLI arguments for metadata dataset path and process count
run_warc_downloader_map: run WarcDownloader mapped over a HuggingFace dataset to download WARC files in parallel
run_save_warc_dataset: run save_to_disk on the WARC dataset to persist downloaded WARC files to disk
run_compute_success_rate: run the success rate computation by counting empty warc_error entries in the dataset
